assumptions.choice: The trailing-stop candidate is High minus the 8-period EMA, ratcheted upward only.
assumptions.reason: The specification defines the EMA as the trailing distance and says the stop follows rising price; High represents the daily price reached.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit levels are detected when the bar High reaches or exceeds the stated price.
assumptions.reason: “Upon reaching the price” is interpreted as an intraday price touch on daily OHLC bars.

assumptions.choice: If High reaches 192.95, the final take-profit closes the entire remaining position instead of submitting a separate 50% exit first.
assumptions.reason: Both thresholds are satisfied, and the final rule requires the remaining position to be closed.

assumptions.choice: Position size is 2% of current broker value divided by initial stop-loss distance, allowing fractional share sizes.
assumptions.reason: This exactly caps the calculated initial stop-loss exposure at 2% while allowing a literal 50% partial close.
